Synopsis

The April 2026 Checkmarx wave reached additional official distribution channels after the March TeamPCP incident. Checkmarx reported malicious AST GitHub Action, KICS DockerHub, and IDE extension artifacts on April 22, shifting the exposure from a single March day into a later release-channel cleanup problem. The record keeps those artifacts together while preserving their package, version, and distribution-specific details.
